name: Rejection Reason 51 Code
definition: Specifies a reason why the instruction/cancellation request has a rejected status.

ADEA.name: Account Servicer Deadline Missed
ADEA.definition: Transaction/instruction received after the account servicer's specified deadline.

DCAN.name: Rejected Since Already Cancelled
DCAN.definition: Cancellation request was rejected since the instruction has already been cancelled.

DPRG.name: Rejected Since In Progress
DPRG.definition: Cancellation request has been rejected because the instruction process is in progress or has been processed.

DSEC.name: Invalid Security
DSEC.definition: Unrecognised or invalid financial instrument identification.

RBIS.name: Rejected By Issuer Or Registrar
RBIS.definition: Issuer or registrar has rejected the instruction.

SAFE.name: Safekeeping Account Rejection
SAFE.definition: Unrecognised or invalid message sender's safekeeping account.
